entities.name: User
entities.rationale: User icon at the left of the middle row, labelled USER; '300k' requests per minute written below it. Standalone, not inside any box.

entities.name: CloudFront
entities.rationale: CloudFront icon labelled CLOUDFRONT in the middle row; CDN receiving the user traffic. Standalone.

entities.name: S3
entities.rationale: S3 bucket icon labelled S3 in the top row above CloudFront; stores static content and images served via CloudFront. Standalone.

entities.name: Lambda
entities.rationale: Lambda icon labelled LAMBDA in the bottom row below CloudFront; used at the edge to decide region/device routing for CloudFront traffic. Standalone.

entities.name: Load Balancer
entities.rationale: Load balancer icon labelled LOAD BALANCER in the middle row, annotated '60' (about 60 load balancers); routes between backend/frontend and legacy/new. Standalone.

entities.name: Legacy
entities.rationale: EC2 instances icon labelled LEGACY in the top row; legacy monolithic systems hosted on EC2. Standalone.

entities.name: EKS
entities.rationale: EKS icon labelled EKS in the middle row, annotated '80' and '250' (80% migrated, 250+ microservices); core for backend and micro frontend services. Standalone.

entities.name: Mongo/Kafka
entities.rationale: Database icon labelled MONGO/KAFKA in the top right; self-managed MongoDB and Kafka running on EC2 per transcript. Drawn as a standalone icon, not inside a box.

entities.name: RDS
entities.rationale: RDS icon labelled RDS at the right of the middle row; transactional SQL databases for some services. Standalone.

entities.name: EC2
entities.rationale: EC2 icon labelled EC2 in the bottom row; hosts self-managed monitoring tools (Prometheus, ELK) per transcript. Standalone.

entities.name: CloudWatch
entities.rationale: CloudWatch icon labelled CLOUDWATCH in the bottom row; monitors pod health. Standalone.

visual_connections.description: Curved pink arrow from above the User icon to the top of CloudFront; user traffic (300k requests/min) goes through CloudFront.
Pink arrow from below the S3 icon down to CloudFront; S3 serves static content and images through CloudFront.
Pink arrow from the top of Lambda up to CloudFront; Lambda at the edge decides region/device routing.
Curved pink arrow from CloudFront to the Load Balancer (annotated 60).
Pink arrow curving up from the Load Balancer to the LEGACY EC2 icon; routing to legacy systems.
Pink arrow from the Load Balancer to EKS; routing to the new microservices.
Pink arrow curving up from EKS to the MONGO/KAFKA icon; microservices use self-managed Mongo and Kafka.
Pink arrow from EKS to RDS; some services use transactional SQL databases.

Thin pink curved line with no arrowhead running from the left side of the EC2 icon up toward the area below CloudFront / Load Balancer; endpoint is ambiguous, appears to be a monitoring bracket being drawn.
